# Plantilla dorada de acceso (ejemplo)
+ service password-encryption
+ hostname SW-ACC-\d+
- ip http server
- snmp-server community .*
line vty .*
 + transport input ssh
 + access-class ACL-VTY in( vrf-also)?
 - transport input .*telnet.*
? interface Vlan\d+
 + no ip proxy-arp
control-plane
 + service-policy input .*
